description: The hash-chained decision log: verifier results for intact, edited, deleted, reordered, inserted, truncated and re-chained logs. A chain alone cannot see tail truncation or a full re-chain; a pinned head can.

cases.title: an intact log of five entries verifies
an empty log verifies with no head
an intact log verifies against its pinned head
a log that has grown past the pin verifies (the pin is a lower bound)
an edited payload: the entry hash no longer matches
a deleted middle entry: sequence gap
two entries swapped: sequence out of order
an entry inserted by copying a neighbour with a changed payload: its hash does not match
an unknown entry kind is refused
a log of another log id fails at the genesis link
tail truncation without a pin verifies: the chain alone cannot see it
tail truncation against a pinned head is refused
edit plus full re-chain without a pin verifies: the chain alone cannot see it
edit plus full re-chain against a pinned head is refused
a last entry that carries another entry hash
a decision.issued entry without its nonce member is refused
an approval.cast entry whose identity is not a string is refused
a decision.issued entry with a null grantHash and a null policyHash is valid (a seat without a Grant requirement)
a decision.issued entry that lacks the grantHash member altogether is refused: null is a value, absence is not
an approval.cast entry that carries both requestHash and exceptionHash is refused
an approval.cast entry for an exception carries exceptionHash instead of requestHash and is valid
entry times (at) that go backwards still verify: at is evidence, the sequence is the order
an at that is not an integer is refused
members beyond the required ones are allowed in a payload
a binding.refused entry with only requestHash, seat and reason is valid
